profile.headline: Senior Software Developer | Full-Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary: Results driven software engineer with experience designing and building scalable web applications, backend APIs, microservices, and internal platform tooling. Strong background in Java/Spring Boot, Ruby on Rails, Vue.js, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure. Proven ability to lead technical initiatives, architect backend systems, and deliver production ready solutions across the full software development lifecycle.
